optimizedContext.value:
# Spec Layout

## Rules
- `_global/<topic>/`: cross-cutting constraints binding all packages
- `<package>/`: package-internal (short name: core, cli, mcp, skills, schema-std); not binding on other packages
- Each spec: kebab-case subdir with `spec.md` (requirements) + `verify.md` (WHEN/THEN); always paired; no scenarios in spec.md; no requirement prose in verify.md
- `spec.md` structure: `# Title`, `## Purpose`, `## Requirements` (`### Requirement: <Name>`), optional `## Constraints`, `## Examples`, `## Spec Dependencies`, `## ADRs`
- `verify.md`: `# Verification: <Title>`, scenarios under matching `### Requirement: <Name>` with `#### Scenario: <Name>`; GIVEN/WHEN/THEN format
- `## Spec Dependencies`: required; `_none_` or `_none — this is a global constraint spec_`; canonical label `` `<workspace>:<capability-path>` `` with optional relative link

## Constraints
- `_global/` cross-cutting only
- Exactly two authored files per spec subdir: spec.md + verify.md
- Delta files live in change dirs, never synced to specs/
- kebab-case subdir names
- Package specs not binding on other packages
